## Issue: Attested mould sense leaves цвести ambiguous

**File:** `C:\Users\stop-\learning-japanese-ru\words\吹く.md:9`
**Severity:** Medium
**Problem:** Actual 咲く caption «цвести» can denote the surface-growth sense of 吹く; no direct exclusion exists.
**Evidence:** Newly accessed [Kotobank, 精選版日本国語大辞典, 吹く [1]⑧/[2]⑩](https://kotobank.jp/word/吹く-617068) explicitly includes mould appearing on a surface. Newly accessed [Dahl, цвет → Цвести](https://lexicography.online/explanatory/dal/ц/цвет) explicitly gives covering with mould, without a local regional qualifier. This is real historical dictionary attestation, not a claim of modern frequency. The saved Wiktionary section does NOT attest mould/rust; sprouting buds alone does not establish flowering. Confidence: high for this attested overlap.
**Suggested fix:** Append `咲く`. No rust assertion is needed; that specific Russian rust claim remains UNVERIFIED.
